title: The Detection of Spatially Resolved Protostellar Outflows and Episodic Jets in the Outer Galaxy
question: Whether protostellar outflows and jets exist and are spatially resolvable in the low-metallicity outer Galaxy, whether their physical properties resemble inner-Galaxy sources, and how the SiO/CO ratio in the jet compares

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration in CASA 6.4.1.12, uvcontsub, tclean cubes (Briggs 0.5), one round of phase self-calibration (SMM1 only), impbcor
key_parameters: phase self-calibration, one round, 60 s solution interval (Sh 2–283–1a SMM1)

recipe.goal: separate core, outflow and jet velocity components in CO(3-2)
recipe.method: Core/outflow boundary from FWTM (1.8 x FWHM) of a Gaussian fit to HCO+ J=4-3 at the continuum peak; outflow/jet terminal velocities from emission morphology, line shape, channel-map bullets and a 3 sigma rms cut
key_parameters: HCO+ Gaussian fit spectrum from a 0.89'' x 0.70'' elliptical region at the 0.87-mm continuum peak
CO spectra extracted from a 4.0'' x 10.0'' elliptical region around the continuum peak
assumptions: Bullet structures appear near Vobs ~50 km/s, marking the outflow terminal velocity

recipe.goal: map outflow and jet integrated intensity and measure the SiO jet
recipe.method: Integrate CO channels over each velocity component for maps; for SiO, extract a spectrum from a 0.70'' diameter aperture at the SiO jet peak and fit a Gaussian to define the velocity range

recipe.goal: derive outflow and jet dynamical properties
recipe.method: Dynamical timescale t_d = (L_obs/V_obs)(cos i / sin i); mass M_out = 2 mu_p m_p X_CO integral(T_CO dV); momentum, mass-loss rate, force, energy and kinetic luminosity derived for each lobe
key_parameters: mean atomic mass per H atom 1.41
assumptions: Inclination i = 45 deg to the line of sight
CO optically thin and in LTE for both outflow and jet
Median velocity of each component taken as the representative flow velocity

recipe.method: Scale the luminosity of the LMC hot core ST16 by Ks magnitude and distance; cross-check with an outflow mass-luminosity correlation
assumptions: Single-band scaling from ST16 (full SED of SMM1 unavailable), large uncertainty acknowledged

recipe.goal: measure episodic ejection intervals from the PV diagram
recipe.method: Position-velocity diagram along the flow axis; time interval = inverse of the slope of each spine-like structure (S1-S3)
key_parameters: PV cut along the flow axis at position angle 1.1 deg

recipe.goal: derive CO and SiO column densities and N(SiO)/N(CO) in the jet bullet (LTE)
recipe.method: Optically thin LTE upper-level column density formula, spectra from a 0.35'' radius circle at the SiO jet peak, spectroscopic data from CDMS, T_rot taken from literature
key_parameters: T_rot(SiO) = 100–500 K and T_rot(CO) = 11 K (L1448 comparison); T_rot = 150 K for both (Orion comparison)
assumptions: CO and SiO optically thin and in LTE
T_rot unknown because only one transition per molecule is detected

recipe.goal: test the non-LTE effect on N(SiO)/N(CO)
recipe.method: RADEX non-LTE calculations for SiO(8-7) and CO(3-2) with a grid in kinetic temperature and H2 density
key_parameters: n(H2) = 1e5–1e6 cm^-3; background temperature 2.73 K; linewidths 8.5 (SiO) and 9.1 (CO) km/s; peak intensities 0.15 (SiO) and 1.45 (CO) K
assumptions: Gas density of jet bullets 1e5-1e6 cm^-3 from literature

recipe.goal: measure outflows in the other four outer-Galaxy sources
recipe.method: Same dynamical-property procedure as for Sh 2–283–1a SMM1 with i = 45 deg, spectra from elliptical regions covering each outflow

score_reason: Project code and CASA/pipeline versions, Briggs robust and the main equations are given, but cube geometry, masks, line-free channels, region definitions and T_rot choices are missing, and no code is released; key numbers are given in tables.
rediscovery_reason: Single Cycle 9 project code (2022.1.01270.S) with named pipeline and CASA versions, standard equations and numeric outputs (masses, timescales, SiO/CO ratios) make a redo of the main results feasible, although public status is not stated and several imaging parameters must be chosen by the reproducer.
